questions: How many chains did you assemble (per length, region, tip and cooldown), and how many showed the Cr12 pattern of a central gap with zero-bias weight at both ends?
Why were the others set aside, for example chains broken by the strain of Sec. S6?
Which other lengths did you measure (Cr6, Cr7, Cr9 to Cr11, beyond 12), and any spectra in field or at other temperatures?
What does the second-best long chain look like?
Which end of Cr12 received the last atoms, and does the stronger end in Fig. 4(b) follow it? Have you tried a defect or extra atom at one end while following both end states?
The 16.8 µeV splitting and ξM ≃ 10.5 Å are calculated. Which αR (1.8, 2.5 or 3.6 eV·Å) and mass m in Eq. (1) did you use, and how does ξM change if the model reproduces the measured 204 ± 50 µeV gap?

Fig. 3 (electron-hole exchange, spin texture) is calculated and the tip was non-magnetic PtIr. Could the summary mark which items are measured and which calculated, and is a spin-polarized tip possible?

What setpoint did the spectra in Figs. 2(a), 4(b) and S1 use, constant height or feedback re-stabilized per point, and which figure holds the microwave data called Fig. S5 in the main text and Fig. 4 in Sec. S8?
